checks.name: canonical-page-offset
checks.run:
from types import SimpleNamespace
from mission_control.funnel_http import offset
parts=['api','apps','sample-one','funnels']
handler=SimpleNamespace(command='GET',path='/api/apps/sample-one/funnels?offset=100')
assert offset(handler,parts)==100, 'Canonical page offset must preserve the requested page'
